title: Margined Protocol (Neutron + Osmosis) — L2 Phase-2 deep dive
closed_reasons: Osmosis redemption vaults (TIARedemption/ATOMRedemption/OSMORedemption, $9,506): deposit AND redeem revert — handler dispatches a `feed` submessage to the feedr contract (code 1887) which does not implement `feed`; assets stuck (S) until privileged feedr migration

LSD vault round trips break-even: stOSMO deposit->redeem returns 1.418982 OSMO-equiv for 1 stOSMO at the on-chain swap rate (1 stOSMO = 1.418482 OSMO); net +0.035% (no extraction). Earlier +11% figure was a stale DefiLlama stOSMO price artifact
bOSMO/stTIA/qOSMO LSD vault deposits revert or panic (slippage bound / failed swap estimate / division by zero) -> banks not reachable
Neutron fund vaults ATOMFund/wBTCUSDC/NTRNUSDC/TIAUSDC/ATOMUSDC/TIAFund have zero bank balances (assets withdrawn by controllers; accounting only) -> nothing to take
Admin/controller functions gated: pause/set_open/update_config -> `Caller is not admin`; repay/process_withdrawal -> `Unauthorized` (dry-run verified)
Neutron escrow claims are user-scoped: user claim OK, non-user -> `No redemptions found` (H-O, not E-U)
ATOMdATOM fund vault is NAV-proportional (public fund source); no unprivileged path identified

poc.note: Cosmos chains: no Foundry project. CI job ci/run.sh -> ci/verify.py performs read-only public-LCD queries + /cosmos/tx/v1beta1/simulate dry-runs (dummy signature, never broadcast, state discarded). Checks: stOSMO round trip, ampOSMO round trip, on-chain stOSMO->OSMO price + net P&L, 2 redemption-vault deposit reverts, escrow user claim, escrow non-user claim, admin gate.

key_facts: Triage $11,031.97 = sum of vault `total_assets` self-reports; actual custody split differs: Osmosis redemption vaults $9,506 (stuck), LSD vault banks $184, Neutron ATOMdATOM $436, escrow $8,369 (missed by triage), NTRNStructured $0.00

Neutron escrow `neutron1rl7key2jr285vwz79hgkusgtw3ylcgateux5p8ajkk4rya067dkserkva8` holds 5,000.249999 ATOM in 4 pending redemptions (3 users); all 4 sourced from Hydro Hedging Strategy (shared locust-framework escrow), not Margined vaults
Deployed redemption-vault/locust-vault WASM downloaded from chain; vault-standard pricing queries are stubbed with `unimplemented!()` (convert_to_shares/convert_to_assets panic)
On-chain executable price: 1 stOSMO = 1.418482 OSMO (simulated pool-1252 swap); stOSMO round trip net +0.035% => no extraction

Conditional: ampOSMO LSD vault pays 1.165420 OSMO per 1 ampOSMO deposited; profitable only if ampOSMO market value < 1.1654 OSMO; capped by vault bank 288.35 OSMO (~$12); ampOSMO pool 1923 is broken (`ran out of ticks`) so the discount is not demonstrated (low confidence)
All admins/owners/controllers are team EOAs; no permissionless function pays the caller (crank = fees to treasury / rebalance only)
caveats: USD prices: OSMO $0.0418508, ATOM $1.67378, TIA $0.52853, stOSMO from on-chain swap (1.418482 OSMO), bOSMO/qOSMO from on-chain swaps, ampOSMO at OSMO proxy; stTIA valued at TIA (proxy, likely understates)
Values are point-in-time (2026-10-15 ~06:48 UTC); CL position values inferred from payout events
Read-only: simulate dry-runs only, no signing/broadcast; no transactions sent
Redemption-vault source is not public; behaviour proven by dry-runs + WASM strings only
Escrow ATOM is user-claimable (H-O) and largely belongs to a Hydro strategy redemption
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live: the $11K triage custody is $9.5K stuck in Osmosis redemption vaults bricked by a `feed`-submessage incompatibility, $8.4K user-claimable escrow (mostly Hydro), $436 pro-rata ATOMdATOM, and $184 in LSD vault banks whose deposit/redeem paths are blocked or break-even at true on-chain prices (one conditional ampOSMO path ≤$12, low confidence).
